invalid_tcg.body: In the Official Card Game, Evilswarm Coppelia uses "leaves the field due to your opponent". The TCG would commonly localize this as "because of your opponent's card", without additional qualification.

en.answer: If you choose <<9996>> as the monster to Tribute during the resolution of your opponent's <<4889>>, the effect of <<9996>> cannot be activated.
en.question: My opponent resolves <<4889>>, requiring me to Tribute a monster I control. If I Tribute my <<9996>>, can I then activate its effect in the Graveyard?
en.title: If my opponent resolves <<4889>>, and I Tribute my <<9996>>, can <<9996>>'s effect then be activated?

ja.answer: 相手が発動した「<<4889>>」の『モンスター1体をリリースしなければならない』処理を自分が行う際に、自分フィールド上に存在する「<<9996>>」をリリースする事を選んだ場合、「<<9996>>」の効果は発動しません。
